name: attraction-shortform-system
description: PLUGIN 3 — the Short-Form Attraction Engine (Week 3). The daily Instagram engine that gets the member in front of agents and builds familiarity, trust and authority: the 5 content pillars (Authority · Perspective · Story · Proof · Personality), bios with a recruiter CTA, Reel scripts by content type, carousels, the daily story rotation, green-screen reactions to brokerage news, the 30-hook bank, the 30-day calendar and weekly routine, the escalating CTA ladder with the ManyChat keyword on every Reel, comment-to-DM hand-off to the conversation engine, optimizer, publishing through the member's own tool, batch publishing, and analytics on which Reels produced agent DMs. Reads the Agent Attraction Brain; requires Plugin 1.
